name: fibtec-marketplace
description: Claude Code plugins for Fibtec Limited's products: pyvar (risk computation), ETL Integrator and TenGrade. A catalogue only: each plugin lives and is released in its own repository.

plugins.name: pyvar-market-risk
plugins.description: 71 functions: VaR, ES, stress, Greeks, P&L attribution, backtesting, GARCH, FRTB SA/IMA

plugins.name: pyvar-credit-risk
plugins.description: 55 functions: PD/LGD/EAD, IRB/SA, XVA full suite, IFRS 9 ECL, CDS, SA-CCR, scoring

plugins.name: pyvar-liquidity-risk
plugins.description: 40 functions: LCR, NSFR, HQLA, cash flow, ILAAP, intraday, LiqVaR

plugins.name: pyvar-operational-risk
plugins.description: 44 functions: LDA, AMA, SMA, RCSA, KRI, scenario, BEICF, cyber/model/IT risk

plugins.name: pyvar-portfolio-analytics
plugins.description: 50 functions: Markowitz/BL/risk-parity, Sharpe/Sortino, Brinson, FF5, PCA, HMM, ESG

plugins.name: pyvar-regulatory
plugins.description: 30 functions: Basel III/IV, FRTB, ICAAP/SREP, MiFID II, EMIR, Solvency II, CRR2

plugins.name: pyvar-derivatives
plugins.description: 62 functions: BS/Heston/SABR/Dupire/LSM, exotic options, bonds, IRS/CDS, FX

plugins.name: pyvar-alm
plugins.description: 33 functions: Duration gap, NII/EVE, IRRBB 6 shocks, repricing, NMD, FTP

plugins.name: pyvar-arch-api-gateway
plugins.description: Arch: FastAPI, Pydantic v2, JWT and API-key auth, orjson, rate limiting, OpenAPI

plugins.name: pyvar-arch-data-ingestion
plugins.description: Arch: Polars lazy scan, PyArrow, Parquet, Arrow IPC, schema validation

plugins.name: pyvar-arch-compute
plugins.description: Arch: NumPy/Numba JIT, SciPy, Dask, Ray, Celery+Redis task dispatch

plugins.name: pyvar-arch-storage
plugins.description: Arch: Redis cache, PostgreSQL/SQLAlchemy, S3/MinIO Parquet object store

plugins.name: pyvar-arch-observability
plugins.description: Arch: Prometheus, Grafana, Sentry, Bandit, input validation security

plugins.name: pyvar-mcp
plugins.description: MCP server: all 385 pyvar functions as Claude Code tools, via the live API

plugins.name: etlgen
plugins.description: ETL Integrator: generate ETL scripts, REST and GraphQL connectors and webhook handlers from Claude Code (drives the etlgen command-line client; needs an ETL Integrator account).

plugins.name: tengrade
plugins.description: TenGrade: build, publish and manage exams and candidate instances from Claude Code (needs a TenGrade organisation account; publishing and inviting candidates spend organisation credit).
